description: Elsevier's elsarticle in its single-column preprint format. Its preamble (batch 1, round 2, from GitHub run 41584963423; elsarticle-5p's is the same): (1) \title takes a paragraph, otherwise as elsarticle.cls l.123-125: General's title ends its \parbox with \par, and elsarticle's \def\title stopped at 'Paragraph ended before \title was complete' (15 documents per pair). (2) Where a way loads titlesec, \paragraph gets a format: elsarticle defines it through \secdef, not \@startsection (elsarticle.cls l.1069-1076), so titlesec finds it non-standard and gives it none (titlesec.sty l.1579-1591), and every \paragraph without its own \titleformat stopped at 'No format for this command' (titlesec.sty l.292-296). The format is elsarticle's own: run-in, italic, a full stop after the title, 10pt plus 6pt minus 3pt above and 6pt after (l.1073-1076).
